/about.title: About — RAW STRUCTURE
/about.description: Since 1987 Raw Structure has built towers, bridges and industrial buildings with obsessive precision.
h2: From one excavator to 640 people.
Thirty-eight years, six turning points.
Four rules on every site board.
The people who sign the drawings.
Got a site? Let’s build something that stands.
p: We started with one excavator, a borrowed crane and a promise to finish what we start. Thirty-eight years later that promise still runs every site we open.

Raw Structure was founded in 1987 by Hendrik Raaijmakers, a site foreman who was tired of watching good buildings get ruined by bad sequencing. The first job was a harbour warehouse in Rotterdam. It finished eleven days early.

Through the nineties we grew the way buildings grow — one floor at a time. Structural steel came in-house in 1996, civil works followed in 2004, and in 2013 we opened our first offices in New York and Oslo.

Today we are 640 engineers, foremen and trades working across three continents. We still hire people who can read a drawing and swing a hammer, and we still publish every safety statistic we record — good or bad.
We do not chase the biggest contracts. We chase the ones where precision matters: live hospitals, heritage shells, bridges over working rivers. The places where a shortcut is not an option.
One machine, four people and a harbour warehouse in Rotterdam.
Our own detailing office and erection crews for high-rise frames.
Bridges, utilities and marine works join the portfolio.
Offices open in New York and Oslo; 200 people on payroll.
Every handover ships with a live BIM model of the finished asset.
Zero lost-time incidents across all active sites.
Safety is designed in, not bolted on. Every method statement is written with the crew who will use it.
We measure twice and log everything. Millimetres matter when a building has to last a century.
Programme and price are promises. We publish both and we are measured against both.
Low-carbon concrete, reused formwork and zero-landfill targets on every project since 2021.

/.title: RAW STRUCTURE — Construction & Engineering
/.description: Raw Structure is a design-build construction company delivering towers, bridges and industrial buildings that are engineered to last.
h2: Five disciplines. One accountable team.
Floor by floor. No step skipped.
Structures we’ve signed our name on.
What people say after handover.
Field notes & engineering.
Got a site? Let’s build something that stands.
h3: Why we pour concrete at night
Mass timber vs. steel: an honest comparison
p: Raw Structure is a design-build contractor for towers, bridges and industrial buildings — engineered with obsessive precision and delivered without drama.
For 38 years we have turned dirt, steel and concrete into places people trust with their lives. No shortcuts. No surprises. Just structures engineered to outlast the people who built them.
We read the site before we touch it: geotech, groundwater, utilities, neighbours and logistics — mapped, scanned and priced.
Shoring, dewatering and bulk earthworks sequenced around live streets, with real-time monitoring on every retaining wall.
Piles, rafts and cores poured to tolerance. Every cube tested, every rebar cage photographed and logged before the pour.
Steel and concrete rise floor by floor with jump-form cores, just-in-time deliveries and a crane plan updated daily.
Commissioning, snagging and a digital twin of the finished building — delivered with the keys, not six months later.
“They handed over Meridian Tower five weeks early and the snag list fit on one page. I have never seen that in 25 years of development.”
“Raw Structure closed zero shipping lanes during the Kessel Bridge launch. Their temporary works engineering was simply world class.”
Head of Infrastructure, City of Hamburg
“On a live hospital campus, noise and vibration were everything. They built around our patients like it was their own family inside.”
